font.reason: No live Persian copy is rendered by this card; Vazirmatn is loaded by FaRoot as the neutral, well-covered Persian UI default for any inherited page chrome and keeps the card contract consistent.

rtlDecisions.action: Wrapped the composition in FaRoot with direction:rtl and Vazirmatn loaded.
rtlDecisions.why: The localized card must establish Persian RTL context even though its visible content is entirely raster page material.

rtlDecisions.action: Kept the three columns centered in their source order.
rtlDecisions.why: This is a balanced physical wall, not a horizontal reading sequence; reordering columns would change the intended parallax silhouette and differential-motion proof.

rtlDecisions.action: Kept the source directions unchanged: outer columns up and middle column down.
rtlDecisions.why: The alternating vertical flow is the core motion design and is physical/content flow rather than an RTL horizontal reading cue.

rtlDecisions.action: Kept perspective, rotateX, scale, masks, loop durations [12, 9, 14], column width, gap, and 1.0-to-1.06 camera push unchanged.
rtlDecisions.why: These parameters define the source card's 3D wall, seamless looping, and slow push; no RTL change is required.

text.notes: There are no JSX/SVG/canvas strings in the composition.

rasterHandling.action: Repointed the card's texture lookup to the checked-in textures/live set and applied filter: blur(16px) plus a 1.04 scale cover to each screenshot slice.
rasterHandling.why: The source screenshots contain baked English/Chinese UI copy that cannot be translated in JSX. Strong blur preserves the page-card texture and motion while preventing foreign text from remaining legible.

comps.timing: All source timing, loop periods, direction signs, easing/transform behavior, fps, dimensions, and duration remain unchanged.
